copy.curiosityHook: As storms rage and predators circle, the parents must trade duties across frozen miles—leaving the fragile egg's survival hanging on precise timing.
copy.description: In Antarctica, thousands of emperor penguins march seventy miles across ice and bitter winter winds to breed, trading off ocean treks and egg protection to keep their offspring alive.
copy.vibeSummary: Deliberate and visually sweeping, balancing polar survival tension with accessible, family-friendly warmth.
copy.whyWatch: Luc Jacquet pairs intimate parental devotion with striking polar vistas, crafting a wildlife portrait that balances dramatic survival stakes with warmth and humor.

allowedMaterial: parent penguins taking turns guarding eggs and seeking food
